summary: Iteration 100: Buy Plan Persistence & Approval Workflow (Phase B) - All backend and frontend tests passed. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed for buy plan CRUD endpoints (generate, list, get, update item qty, approve, delete). Frontend: All UI elements verified - plan generation controls, plan selector, status badges, approve/delete buttons, summary cards, buy plan table with 173 SKUs, calculation breakdown modal, edit functionality with save/cancel.

TEST_04_list_plans_success.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/buy-plans returns plans array without items

TEST_06_get_plan_success.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/buy-plans/{plan_id} returns full plan with items array

TEST_09_update_item_qty_success.notes: PUT /api/buy-planning/buy-plans/{plan_id}/items updates qty, adds edited_qty/edited_by fields

TEST_16_update_approved_fails.notes: Updating item in approved plan returns 400

TEST_18_generate_button.notes: data-testid=generate-plan-btn present with text 'Generate & Save Plan'

TEST_20_status_badge_draft.notes: data-testid=plan-status-badge shows DRAFT for new plans

TEST_23_summary_cards.notes: 4 summary cards: SKUs (173), Total Buy Qty (448,201), Buy Value (₹942.6M), Display Min Qty (35,638)

TEST_24_buy_plan_table.notes: data-testid=buy-plan-table with 50 rows showing SKU, Mix, ROS/day, SOH, Demand, Display Min, Safety, Buy Qty, Value, Constraint

TEST_25_eye_icon_buttons.notes: 50 eye icon buttons (data-testid=detail-btn-{idx}) for calculation breakdown

TEST_26_calc_breakdown_modal.notes: data-testid=calc-breakdown-modal shows SKU, Style, Style Mix, Category, Daily ROS, Forecasted Demand, Sell-Through Target, Current SOH, Demand Buy, Display Minimum, Safety Stock, MRP, Constraint, Final Buy Qty, Buy Value

TEST_27_edit_mode_activation.notes: Clicking edit button on buy qty column shows input field

TEST_28_quantity_update.notes: Entering new qty and saving shows 'Quantity updated' toast, value persists with 'edited' label

TEST_29_totals_recalculation.notes: Total Buy Qty and Buy Value update after edit (452,432 qty, ₹957.4M value)

TEST_30_approve_click.notes: Clicking Approve button shows 'Plan approved' toast

TEST_32_buttons_hidden_after_approve.notes: Approve and Delete Draft buttons hidden after approval

TEST_33_delete_click.notes: Clicking Delete Draft shows 'Plan deleted' toast

TEST_34_plan_removed.notes: Plan selector resets to '-- Select a saved plan --'

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - React hydration warning. Minor issue, does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend buy plan CRUD endpoints correctly implemented at /api/buy-planning/buy-plans/*
Generate endpoint creates plan with status='draft' and stores items array with full calculation details
List endpoint excludes items array for performance (projection: {items: 0})
Get single plan endpoint returns full items array with all calculation fields
Update item endpoint correctly validates draft status, item_index bounds, and recalculates totals
Approve endpoint changes status to 'approved' and records approved_at/approved_by
Delete endpoint correctly validates draft status before deletion
Frontend Buy Plan tab has all required data-testid attributes for testing
Plan generation controls (cover period selector, generate button) work correctly
Plan selector dropdown lists saved plans with status and date
Status badge correctly shows DRAFT/APPROVED with appropriate styling
Approve/Delete buttons only visible for draft plans
Summary cards show SKUs, Total Buy Qty, Buy Value, Display Min Qty
Buy plan table shows all calculation columns with eye icon for breakdown modal
Calculation breakdown modal shows complete formula details
Edit functionality works with input field, save/cancel, and 'edited' label
seed_data_creation: Test plans created during testing were cleaned up. Database has 30 stores (17 A, 9 B, 4 C), 173 SKUs, 20 Core styles.
